claims.claim_text: Established a policy-gated agent execution surface for governed enterprise AI workflows by defining deterministic route-policy dispatch, GraphRAG context-pack grounding, and human override escalation paths.
Advanced enterprise AI platform adoption through CFO-aligned adoption motions, connecting workflow value to usage-based forecasting and reusable commercialization patterns.
Strengthened production confidence with audit-grade runtime observability coverage for regulated AI workflows, pairing evaluation gates with telemetry and rollback controls.

Standardized production-readiness gates across the AI solution lifecycle, using managed workflow orchestration and replayable runtime design to move deployments from intake through monitored operation.
Architected high-availability distributed service patterns for enterprise AI platforms, integrating AWS and Databricks Lakehouse data flows with vector services and parallel decision workflows.
Scaled the engineering team from 8 to 28 while commercializing reusable AI platform capability through agentic platform productization and a scalable operating model.
